description: The selectors and topics of the ABIs the agent, the validators' members, the runners and the SDKs call (SF9): every function selector, event topic0 and error selector of the files of abi/ named in `abis`, the entries this line changed with their previous signature and value, the entries it added, and the two signals a client reads the generation from. Every consumer's ABI test checks the entries it uses against this file.
source: abi/ (node scripts/export-abi.js after npx hardhat compile)
rule: a function's and an error's selector is the first 4 bytes of keccak256 of its canonical signature (tuples as their component types in parentheses); an event's topic0 is the whole keccak256

signals.rule: the add form and doStamp's arity follow the PoX's VERSION(); the claims path and the strict stored-result grammar follow the pricing's matching() read from the chain, never a static descriptor (OD18 A)

the PoX 2.0 sets deployed on bloxberg testnet and Polygon Amoy (EthernityImplementationV2_1_2)

matching.rule: the pricing's PoxMatching; the zero address on a network whose pricing names none: no claims path, the stored result read as before the strict grammar
